title: PREVIA: LLM ensemble predicts PTSD risk from emergency department trauma narratives
summary: PREVIA, a clinically informed LLM ensemble, predicts PTSD one month after trauma from emergency department narratives in 145 patients at two New York City trauma centers. It reached AUROC 78.49% plus or minus 5.75% and performed comparably to a specialized clinician on 30 patients. The authors note the precision is about 47%, and the study is an ongoing single-region cohort.
ai_technology: PREVIA clinically informed large language model ensemble
organization: New York University Grossman School of Medicine

evidence.tested: Predicted PTSD at one month in 145 patients and compared the model with an emergency clinician on 30 random patients.
evidence.unknown: Precision is about 47% (AUROC 78.49%) with wide standard deviations; the abstract describes an ongoing longitudinal study and a small sample.
evidence.ai_role: LLM ensemble extracts early post-traumatic stress symptoms, risk and protective factors from narratives and produces the risk forecast.
